name: mcfunction-formatter
description: Formatter for .mcfunction files in Minecraft Java Edition (1.21+) data packs

mcfunctionFormatter.indent.enabled.markdownDescription: Indents lines by the number of `#` in the `##` (or deeper) heading above them: one level under `##`, two under `###`. A single `#` is a plain comment. A blank line goes back one level. When off, each line keeps its original indentation.

mcfunctionFormatter.indent.size.markdownDescription: Number of spaces per indentation level. `-1` follows the VS Code indentation setting.

mcfunctionFormatter.header.enabled.markdownDescription: Inserts a `#> namespace:path` header derived from `data/<namespace>/function/<path>.mcfunction`, and overwrites an existing header whose path differs.

mcfunctionFormatter.command.keepLineBrea.markdownDescription: In plain commands (including `execute` that is not split into subcommands), keeps the `` line breaks written between words, indenting continuation lines one level. When off, joins them into one line.

enumDescriptions: Put each subcommand on its own line

mcfunctionFormatter.execute.indentSize.markdownDescription: Number of spaces per level for execute continuation lines. `-1` follows the VS Code indentation setting.

enumDescriptions: Put each argument on its own line
Keep on one line, only tidy spacing
mcfunctionFormatter.selector.mode.markdownDescription: How to format selectors (`@e[...]` etc.) and the `scores={...}` / `advancements={...}` maps inside them

mcfunctionFormatter.selector.indentSize.markdownDescription: Number of spaces per level when expanding selectors. `-1` follows the VS Code indentation setting.

mcfunctionFormatter.selector.equalsSpace.markdownDescription: Number of spaces around `=` in selectors, and around `=` / `~` in block states and item components (`1` gives `type = zombie`). `-1` keeps what was written.

mcfunctionFormatter.selector.commaSpaces.markdownDescription: Number of spaces after `,` when selector arguments share a line. `-1` keeps what was written.

enumDescriptions: Put each element on its own line
Keep on one line, only quote keys and tidy spacing
mcfunctionFormatter.nbt.mode.description: How to format NBT / JSON (text components, macro arguments, etc.)

mcfunctionFormatter.nbt.indentSize.markdownDescription: Number of spaces per level when expanding NBT. `-1` follows the VS Code indentation setting.

mcfunctionFormatter.nbt.colonSpaces.markdownDescription: Number of spaces after the `:` following an NBT key. `-1` keeps what was written.

mcfunctionFormatter.nbt.commaSpaces.markdownDescription: Number of spaces after `,` when NBT elements share a line. `-1` keeps what was written.

enumDescriptions: Expand the NBT inside according to nbt.mode
Keep on one line, only tidy `=` / `~` spacing and the NBT inside
mcfunctionFormatter.attached.mode.markdownDescription: How to format `{...}` / `[...]` attached to a word (block states, item components, block entity NBT, NBT paths like `A[{B:true}]`)
